blurb: Step into the vibrant heart of Kissimmee and immerse yourself in the nostalgic charm of Old Town! This enchanting entertainment district is a kaleidoscope of fun, offering an eclectic mix of delightful dining, unique shopping experiences, and thrilling rides for the young and young at heart.

quotes.author: Michael
quotes.text: I always enjoy coming here. Lots of things to do. Bars stores games rides food they have it all. There's always something going on here from concerts to car shows.

quotes.author: Romy Coers
quotes.text: Absolute highlight from our trip. The atmosphere is wonderful. Lots of live music and some lovely bars. We stayed to see the parade of cars, which was a really unique and fun experience. Highly recommend going here!

quotes.author: Annie A
quotes.text: I love visiting old town because of how many things you can do at the same time. They have a lot of restaurants and bars to choose from. The main thing that I love about visiting old town is their car show, as a car enthusiastic I love watching theirs cars.

quotes.author: Amber Steele
quotes.text: Old town was always such a fun place to visit. I loved coming down here just to see all the fun stuff. The old cars, crazy art work and fun colors are a must see.

quotes.author: Tialisa Whipple
quotes.text: We made our 1st trip to Old Town over 14 years ago, and it's even better now. A series of shops and eateries attached to an amusement park. If you want a break from the huge pricey theme parks, this is a nice alternative.

quotes.author: Shane Ball
quotes.text: Old town is an amazing place they have car shows on a weekend live music.
